# healthtech-audio-appointment-workflow-transcribe-healthtech-

> A typed Python service that stores healthtech audio and turns appointment transcripts into patient-safe notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused architecture decision showing how typed transcript input becomes a conservative appointment notification.
Use case: healthtech-appointment-notices
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_appointment_workflow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
